name: Espelkamp (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of black, white and green with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the top with the city arms of Espelkamp (green trees on white above a black and white chequy base).
history: Municipal flag of Espelkamp; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
